title: Design-label identifiability in patient-level single-cell classifiers
description: Code, restored donor metadata, 11,200 simulation replicates, complete-pipeline null distributions, locked predictions, source tables, figures and manuscript assets for a study of design-label identifiability in patient-level single-cell classifiers. The release defines a design-adjusted label-information fraction and evaluates frozen Geneformer donor means, expression pseudobulk and CD4-subtype composition using design-only prediction, permutation nulls, representation-to-design recovery, linear and nonlinear fold-contained residualisation, matched overlap restriction, internal negative controls, strict source-only transfer, learned pooling and confound-leakage sensitivity experiments.
